headline: Clinton order created a federal working group to study illegal activity on the Internet.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a federal working group focused on unlawful conduct on the Internet. Based on the title, the group's job was to look at illegal activity online and how the federal government should respond. No summary was provided, so details about the group's members, tasks, or deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in law enforcement
who_it_affects.how: Officials from these agencies would likely take part in or support the working group's study of illegal online activity.
